description: This is a Zephyr RTOS driver source file for a Gecko microcontroller's sleep timer counter, implementing timer start/stop, get/set value, alarm management, and initialization.

methods.name: alarm_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked when an alarm timer expires, calls user-defined callback with current counter value.

methods.name: top_callback
methods.description: Callback invoked when top timer expires, calls user-defined top callback.

methods.name: counter_gecko_get_value
methods.description: Retrieves current counter value based on sleeptimer tick count.

methods.name: counter_gecko_start
methods.description: Starts the top timer if not already running.

methods.name: counter_gecko_stop
methods.description: Stops the top timer if running.

methods.name: counter_gecko_set_top_value
methods.description: Sets the top value for the counter, configures periodic timer, checks for hardware errata.

methods.name: counter_gecko_get_top_value
methods.description: Returns the current top value of the counter.

methods.name: counter_gecko_set_alarm
methods.description: Sets an alarm on the counter, handles absolute and relative timing, manages alarm timers.

methods.name: counter_gecko_init
methods.description: Initializes sleeptimer, configures interrupt, sets initial top value, logs device init.
